purpose: Editorial review schedule. A null lastReviewedAt means no human review date has been recorded; automated link checks do not count as content approval.

sections.label: Career paths, modules and prerequisites
sections.note: Check new skill requirements, outdated tools, role expectations, prerequisite order, and original-source references. Record a date only after a human review.

sections.label: Operating systems and DistroSea catalogue
sections.note: Review supported OS names, versions and online availability against the provider. A prior catalogue snapshot is not proof that a session is currently available.

sections.label: Video and tutorial accuracy (separate from link health)
sections.note: Check whether instructions and screenshots still match current versions; a working URL alone is not an accuracy review.

sections.label: CTF learning-directory access notes and rules
sections.note: Review access conditions, platform rules and official links. Do not label a time-sensitive event live without current organizer data.

sections.label: CyberRange, CTF Arcade and lab fixtures
sections.note: Re-run challenge checks, verify answer keys, keep sample data synthetic, and test that solutions remain reproducible.

sections.label: Offline study pack and cached learning material
sections.note: Verify that standalone packs match current lessons and that the deployed app refreshes the cache after releases.

sections.label: Public cyber-safety guidance and reporting references
sections.note: Recheck official reporting channels and guidance; keep emergency/financial-fraud instructions sourced from official agencies.
